title: Implementation Monitor
description: Tracks climate resilience, livestock infrastructure, pasture restoration, and farmer capacity outcomes for the AfDB-supported livestock project in Zambia.

items.name: Year-round water access for livestock
items.notes: Households with enough water for animals increased from 48% to 89%.

items.name: New production practices for milk
items.notes: 96.7% of households adopted improved milk production practices.

items.name: Pasture restoration and feed resilience
items.notes: Degraded meadows restored and sustainable pasture established.
